descriptions.WORKER_NOT_AT_SHED: Worker u_B > u_A is located elsewhere on farm, cannot pick up without teleporting.
descriptions.ORDER_REVERSED: Worker u_B < u_A executed before depositor u_A deposited into shed.
descriptions.SAME_WORKER_IMPOSSIBLE: Worker u_B == u_A cannot both deposit and pick up / use item in single turn.
descriptions.NO_FREE_ACTION: Worker u_B > u_A is at shed but already committed to higher priority task.
descriptions.ORDER_VALID: Worker u_B > u_A is at shed, executed idle/pass/drop, and could execute same-turn PICKUP.
